Thanks again for your time earlier — excited to get a short walkthrough of Redwood scheduled. I shared a Chili Piper scheduling widget in our last sequence (link below) that should let you pick a slot quickly: https://cal.chili-piper.com/meet/redwood-demo?ref=acme

One thing we've seen a few times: the Chili Piper widget defaults to the browser's timezone. If you're traveling and your laptop/browser is still on a different zone, the times shown can be misleading (I know this happened to a customer who landed in Japan but their browser stayed on PDT). If you're traveling today, can you confirm the timezone your calendar is showing for the event after you pick a slot?

If the widget looks off, reply here with your rough availability and I can send a manual invite (ICS) that encodes the explicit timezone to avoid DST/locale edge cases.

Three quick options I can hold right now (I'll convert to your zone once you pick):
- Option A: Tue Dec 5, 09:00 CET (09:00 Europe/Paris) — good for EU mornings
- Option B: Wed Dec 6, 16:00 JST (16:00 Asia/Tokyo) — good for APAC afternoons
- Option C: Thu Dec 7, 08:00 PST (08:00 America/Los_Angeles) — early US window

If none of those work, tell me two windows and I will push an invite with an explicit TZ.

Thanks — Diego
